notes: §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR6: 'The BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED, PICTURE, SYNCHRONIZED, and VALUE clauses must not be specified for data items whose usage is INDEX.' PICTURE is refused by BindEntry and UsageInheritanceElementary through Sr8PicturelessVerdict (COBOL0881), VALUE by the same members over AdmitsNoValueLiteral (COBOL2168), BLANK WHEN ZERO and JUSTIFIED by CheckClauseSubjectsPass.Run over BlankWhenZeroViolation and JustifiedViolation (COBOL2405), and since kb/Work PB5189 SYNCHRONIZED by SynchronizedViolation, asked by the same pass below dialect level 2002 of the item's written or inherited usage (§1985:VI.5.14.4 GR1), which closes the prior PARTIAL's hole. Probes at --std 85 (classes b, c, d): refused 01 I1 USAGE IS INDEX SYNCHRONIZED, 01 I2 INDEX SYNC RIGHT, 05 J1 SYNC LEFT under 01 G USAGE INDEX, 05 J6 OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEX SYNCHRONIZED, INDEX SYNC SYNC (also COBOL2423), PIC 9, VALUE 1, JUSTIFIED and BLANK WHEN ZERO on an index item and VALUE and BLANK ZERO under a USAGE INDEX group; accepted 01 I9 INDEX and a SYNC numeric item beside an index table; at --std 2023 the SYNC index items compile, the 2023 rule. The witness 01 IX PICTURE 9 USAGE IS INDEX is refused COBOL0881. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5189 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 refuses BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED, PICTURE, SYNCHRONIZED and VALUE on a USAGE INDEX item. 2023 still refuses four of the five: §2023:13.16.3 SR8 (no PICTURE for an item whose usage is index), §2023:13.16.3 SR10 ('The VALUE clause shall not be specified for data items of class index'), §2023:13.18.8.3 SR1 and SR2 (BLANK WHEN ZERO only for numeric or numeric-edited items of usage display or national), and §2023:13.18.32.3 SR3 (JUSTIFIED only for categories alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean or national, while §2023:13.18.60.4 GR10 makes an index item's category index). SYNCHRONIZED is no longer refused: §2023:13.18.55.3 SR1 'The SYNCHRONIZED clause may be specified for group and elementary items', and no 2023 rule excludes index items. A refused program (SYNC on an index item) is now accepted.
